description: This file implements the 'Create' feature for user registration, including request validation, duplicate checks, password hashing, and JWT token issuance in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains records, validator, and handler for creating a new user.

classes.name: Create.UserData
classes.description: Data record holding user input: username, email, password.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating user data for creating a new user, implements IRequest returning UserEnvelope.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure username, email, and password are provided and not empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Processes the user creation command, performing validation, duplicate checks, password hashing, and token generation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method handling the user creation process, including database checks, password hashing, and JWT token creation.
